title: FindingNemo Extraction 2: Phenol-free Method
author: Inswasti Cahyani
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxx2ppqe

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Pellet 3 × 10⁶ cells in a 1.5 ml tube by centrifugation at 1000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellet with PBS (ensure all media and serum are removed) and spin at 1000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and RNase
steps.instruction: Add 149 µl of TLB‑SDS or TLB‑CTAB that has been pre‑mixed with 100 µg RNase A (1 µl). Vortex at full speed for 3 seconds. Prepare a master mix of TLB and RNase A when processing multiple samples.

steps.title: Lysis incubation at 37°C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 140 µl TLB and 200 µg Proteinase K (10 µl). Mix by slow inversion five times or with a wide‑bore P1000 tip.

steps.title: Proteinase K incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at 55 °C for 20 minutes. Optional: shake in a thermomixer at 300–700 rpm to improve lysis, especially for >3 million cells.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 75 µl of 5 M ammonium acetate and mix well with a wide‑bore P1000 tip.

steps.title: Add glass beads
steps.instruction: Add three clean glass beads directly to the cell lysate.

steps.title: Add isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 275 µl of isopropanol to the tube.

steps.title: Mix by rotation
steps.instruction: Rotate the tube on a vertical rotator at 9 rpm for 5 minutes. If a rotator is unavailable, invert the tube by hand 30–40 times (≈4–5 seconds per inversion).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Pipette off and discard the liquid, leaving the DNA bound to the beads.

steps.title: Ethanol wash (1 ml)
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA with 1 ml of 70 % ethanol, invert the tube three times, then remove and discard the ethanol.

steps.title: Ethanol wash (500 µl)
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash with 500 µl of 70 % ethanol. Discard the ethanol carefully, avoiding disturbance of the DNA precipitate.

steps.title: Prepare bead retainer
steps.instruction: Insert a bead retainer into a collection tube, pour the beads into the retainer, and spin for 1 second in a mini‑centrifuge (or the shortest possible time) to remove residual wash buffer. Keep the bead retainer.

steps.title: Transfer beads to elution tube
steps.instruction: Quickly pour the beads into a new 2 ml low‑bind tube and immediately add 250 µl of elution buffer. Do not let the beads dry. (Alternatively, pre‑aliquot 250 µl elution buffer into the tube before this step.)

steps.title: Elute DNA at 37°C
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes. Gently aspirate and dispense the eluate over the glass beads at regular intervals using a wide‑bore P1000 tip to aid elution; mix every 10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge beads into clean tube
steps.instruction: Insert the bead retainer into a clean 2 ml low‑bind tube, pour the beads from the previous step, and centrifuge at 12 000 × g (≈12 000 rpm) for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Quantify DNA and assess homogeneity
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA according to the “UHMW DNA QC” protocol and calculate %CV values. If the DNA is not sufficiently homogeneous, incubate the DNA for a longer period before proceeding.

steps.title: Store DNA or proceed to library prep
steps.instruction: Store the DNA at 4 °C, or continue to ultra‑long library preparation as described in “Modified ULK001”. If only SQK‑RAD004 is available, follow the “Modified RAD004” or “KrazyStarFish (KSF)” library‑preparation protocols. Store at 4 °C for short‑term storage.
